title: Comparatio Adverbiorum
subtitle: Fortiter, fortius, fortissime — comparatio derivata ab adiectivis.
objectives: Formare comparativum adverbii (identicum neutro comparativi adiectivi)
Formare superlativum adverbii (-e ex superlativo adiectivi)
Distinguere adverbium comparativum ab adiectivo comparativo neutro

content.intro: Comparātiō adverbiōrum dērīvātur dīrēctē ā comparātiōne adiectīvōrum, quam iam nōvistī — ergō haec lēctiō est brevis sed ūtilis cōnsolidātiō.
content.explanation: Comparātīvus adverbiī est semper identicus fōrmae neutrī sīngulāris comparātīvī adiectīvī; superlātīvus adverbiī fōrmātur removendō -us ā superlātīvō adiectīvī et addendō -ē.

rules.heading: a) Comparativus: Neutrum Comparativi Adiectivi
rules.body: fortiter (bravely) → comparātīvus fortius (more bravely) — eadem fōrma ac neutrum comparātīvī adiectīvī 'fortior, fortius'.

examples: Bene cantat, sed melius quam ego. — He sings well, but better than I.
Optime omnium scripsit. — He wrote best of all.
Pessime hoc egisti. — You did this most badly.
Magis eam amo quam te. — I love her more than you.

commonMistakes.wrong: Adverbium comparativum tractatur ut distinctum ab neutro comparativi adiectivi, cum forma propria.
commonMistakes.right: 'fortius' servit ambabus functionibus: adverbium comparativum ET adiectivum comparativum neutrum — identica forma, functio determinata per contextum.
commonMistakes.why: Haec est simplificatio elegans systematis: nulla forma nova discenda est.
Adverbia irregularia sequuntur eandem irregularitatem ac adiectiva unde derivantur.

exercises.title: Iunge Adverbium cum Comparativo
exercises.instructions: Iunge quodque adverbium positivum cum comparativo suo.

items.explanation: Comparatio adverbiorum reflectit exactamente comparationem adiectivorum.
